description: An implanted fusion reactor with its own internal nuclear fuel reservoir.  It will last over a century without servicing.

The interior of your femurs have been scrapped clean, the marrow replaced with a Mercurial brand bio-factory that produces high efficiency blood analogues.  The blood substitutes are fine-tuned for combat, increasing stamina, disease resistance and clotting speed.
cant_remove_reason: The biofactory has perfectly integrated with your body, removing it would be pointless and potentially fatal.

description: An implanted miniaturized computer isolated from the rest of your systems by military-grade firewalls.  An accompanying jack allows you to interface with external computer systems with minimal risk.  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.
A high voltage battery port compatible with the power cartridges normally used in military weaponry.  Intended to supplement internally installed power generation and storage.

Your blood is laced with neuron-analogue nanites, allowing your entire circulatory system to function as a secondary brain.  This radical modification increases your intelligence, reflexes and perception by 4, increases your pain tolerance and allows you to survive brain damage that would otherwise prove fatal.

Imagine a computer inside your body playing pong against the universe.  The paddles are made of -color glass condensate- and any and all of their specific functions are the intellectual property of the Hawking Corporation and/or its local subsidiaries.
-From the owners manual of HawkingCorps Mark I Shield.

Activating the shield will create an energy shield capable of negating a modest amount of damage from weak or improvised weapons.

variables.failure_message: Your implant vibrates uncomfortably as the shield fails to activate.

description:
Powerful and covert, the Mark V Shield is a military-grade shielding system developed for the US military's special operations units.  Its operating principles remain classified; the few engineers who worked on it insisted it was reverse-engineered from something recovered rather than invented.

Activating the shield will create an energy barrier capable of withstanding a modest amount of melee and ranged damage.

variables.failure_message: Your implant vibrates uncomfortably as the shield fails to activate.

description: A powerful shielding system salvaged from an experimental military robot, crudely adapted for compatibility with biological hosts.  Powerful enough to withstand prolonged assault from anti-vehicle weaponry.

variables.success_message: All surrounding noise is muted as the barrier coalesces.
variables.failure_message: Your implant vibrates uncomfortably as the shield fails to activate.
